title: Risk-Led Launch Prioritizer & KPI Samplepack
body:
Purpose:
A compact, bias-aware template to prioritize launch sub-features and tie them to measurable KPIs and concrete readiness gates. Use this to decide go/no-go at feature, route, and rollout-phase granularity when tradeoffs exist between speed-to-market and potential user/operational risk.

Quick summary / how to use:
- Fill in the risk rows for each feature or route variant (e.g., prompt A vs prompt B, quantized model vs full-precision).
- Score likelihood, user-impact, and rollback-cost (1-5). Compute RISK_SCORE = likelihood * user-impact * rollback-cost.
- Map each item to 1–3 primary KPIs and one monitoring SQL/event to validate pre- and post-launch.
- Assign owners and minimum gating thresholds per rollout phase (alpha, beta, GA).
- Use data signals during canary to decide (green/amber/red) with automatic fallback plans.

Risk prioritizer template (compact):
- Feature id: FR-xxx
- Short description: one line
- Likelihood of failure (1 low - 5 high):
- User-impact if failure occurs (1 low - 5 high):
- Rollback cost & complexity (1 low - 5 high):
- RISK_SCORE = likelihood * user-impact * rollback-cost (scale 1-125)
- Primary KPIs (3): metric_name | target_delta | measurement_window
- Monitoring event / SQL (see examples below)
- Owner: name (eng/product/ops)
- Minimum gate for alpha/beta/ga: e.g., alpha=manual-ops, beta=1k users, ga=2x adoption and no degraded errors for 72h

Example row (realistic but anonymized):
- Feature id: FR-218
- Short description: Prompt-presets for developer quickstart (three templates)
- Likelihood: 2
- User-impact: 3
- Rollback-cost: 1
- RISK_SCORE: 6
- Primary KPIs:
  - activation_rate (new project created within 48h) | target +5pp vs baseline | 7-day window
  - avg_gen_latency_ms (p95) | target < 300ms | rolling 24h
  - support_tickets_per_1000_users | target < 2 | 14-day window
- Monitoring SQL (example):
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as hour, count(*) filter (where event='project_created')/count(*) as activation_rate
  FROM events
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '14 days' AND feature_flag='prompt_presets'
  GROUP BY 1
- Owner: Priya Kapoor (product)
- Minimum gates: alpha=internal-staff only; beta=early-access cohort (500 MAU); ga=cohort A/B positive on activation and <=1.5x support load

KPI catalogue (pick from these or adapt):
- Activation rate: new_demo_project / new_signups (window configurable). Low-latency target = +absolute delta vs baseline.
- Engagement depth: median_session_msgs_per_user in first 7 days.
- Cost per token (USD): total_gpu_cost / tokens_generated (7-day rolling). Target keep < baseline * 0.95 when enabling quantization.
- Error surface: errors_per_10k_requests (app + model errors). Gate: < 5 errors per 10k for beta, < 2 for GA.
- Latency (p95): end-to-end request time. Gate: p95 < 350ms for GA on hosted tier.
- Model regression index: BLEU/ROUGE-like or eval-acc against golden-prompt set. Gate: no statistically significant drop (p<0.05) vs baseline on critical prompt set.

Readiness checklist (operational + product + infra):
- Product:
  - acceptance criteria documented and linked to test prompts (owner)
  - golden prompt set included in CI eval (PR must pass)
  - UX copy reviewed for error states
- Engineering / infra:
  - automatic rollback toggle implemented and smoke-tested
  - capacity plan for initial cohort (GPU reservation, burst buffer) in infra ticket
  - CI e2e runs with seeded traffic profile
- Observability / SRE:
  - dashboards live (cost, latency, error, adoption) and shared with 2 on-call engineers
  - alert runbook created for top-5 failure modes with pager thresholds
  - tracing hooks added for end-to-end request id
- Customer Ops / CS:
  - canned support responses ready for top-10 issues
  - monitoring for escalations (Slack channel + Ops rotation)

Gating rules (template):
- Alpha (internal): must have unit/integration tests passing + smoke runs. No external users. Manual signoff by eng/product lead.
- Beta (limited public): must meet alpha gates + automated golden-prompt CI + monitoring dashboards + initial adoption threshold (configurable, default 500 MAU or 7-day > x). If any critical alert fires (see alert list) for 24h, auto-fallback to previous model or disable feature flag.
- GA: beta gates plus stability for 72h, error rates < GA thresholds, cost per token within budget. Executive notification upon GA signoff.

Contingency options (ranking):
1) Immediate feature-flag off + rollback to stable model variant (fastest).
2) Throttle traffic / restrict to paid customers only.
3) Route to fallback cheaper model (for cost spikes) with user-facing deprecation banner.
4) Hotfix patch if bug (deploy within 2-hour SLA).

Launch-phase monitoring signals (green/amber/red):
- Green: no alerts for 24h, KPIs trending to target, stable costs.
- Amber: single non-critical alert or KPI drift < 10% vs baseline. Increase monitoring cadence and hold GA.
- Red: critical alert (error spike, safety violation, major regression), trigger rollback.

Example monitoring rules (operationalized):
- Alert A: errors_per_minute > 50 for 5m -> P1 on-call, page SRE
- Alert B: p95_latency_ms > 500ms for 15m -> P1 on-call, page infra
- Alert C: support_tickets_rate > 5 per 1k MAU for 24h -> CustomerOps notify

Data collection & dashboard mapping (quick map):
- activation_rate -> events table, feature_flag filter, 7d moving average, dashboard: product/activation
- avg_gen_latency_ms -> traces + metrics aggregator, rollup by model_variant, dashboard: infra/latency
- token_cost_usd -> billing data joined to model_variant and tokens_generated, dashboard: finance/cost-per-token

Post-launch retrospective triggers (auto-checks for 7 days):
- If KPI delta >= +/-10% and sustained for 48h -> schedule rapid retro + owner action plan
- If any P1 occurred -> mandatory incident review within 72h with SRE + product + CS present
- If cost delta > 20% predicted -> finance + product immediate review and throttle plan

Quick-owner action list (first 24h):
- Owner: check dashboards at 0h, 6h, 12h, 24h and post summary in #launch-ops
- SRE: confirm rollback toggle works and simulate a failover at 12h (no user impact)
- CS: monitor support channel and escalate anything marked ‘security’ or ‘data-loss’ immediately

Pocket checklist (one-pager for launch lead):
- [ ] Golden prompt CI passing
- [ ] Alerts configured + runbook linked
- [ ] Rollback toggle validated
- [ ] Owner + backup on call for first 72h
- [ ] Dashboard shared + read-write for cross-functional leads
- [ ] External comms template drafted (if GA)

Notes-to-self / unresolved questions (scratchpad):
- Decide whether quantized model variant counts as separate feature id for tracking cost/regression (recommended: yes).
- Confirm retention window for tracing (default 30d) vs cost constraints.
- We need an easy UI in console to flip rollback + route traffic on/off; infra ticket pending PR-1284.

Appendix: sample SQLs and simple heuristic checks
- Session depth (7d):
  SELECT user_id, count(*) as msgs
  FROM messages
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND feature_flag='FR-218'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) > 3;

- Cost per token (7d):
  SELECT model_variant, sum(gpu_cost)/sum(tokens) as cost_per_token
  FROM billing_token_rollup
  WHERE date >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY model_variant;

- Regression smoke test (prompt set): run eval harness and compare pass rate to baseline; trigger amber if drop > 3pp, red if > 7pp.

Ownership & escalation contacts (example):
- Product owner: Priya Kapoor (priya@redwood.ai)
- Engineering lead: Liam Nguyen (liam@redwood.ai)
- SRE main: Jonah Reed (jonah@redwood.ai)
- Customer Ops: Samira Khan (samira@redwood.ai)

Last notes: this is intentionally compact — copy into a feature-specific doc and expand the monitoring SQLs for each route. Use the RISK_SCORE to prioritize scheduling of dedicated capacity or extra QA cycles (example heuristics: score > 40 -> require dedicated infra reservation for first 72h).

End of doc.
